name: Wind Dungeon
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one NEW Wind Dungeon mobile battle-page background in this exact game's illustrated style. Input 1 is the approved cave background: match its quiet composition, large simple forms, soft contrast and outline treatment. Input 2 is a style reference for the game's chunky clean silhouettes; do not copy its gate. STYLE: Match the supplied game art: clean chunky cartoon illustration, simple broad 2-3 tone cel-shaded shapes, confident muted dark-plum contours on edge objects, no photorealism, fine texture, tiny cracks, grain, 3D rendering, excessive gradients or intricate details. Theme palette: pale blue-gray, dusty turquoise, ivory and muted cool taupe.
SCENE: A quiet high-altitude wind sanctuary, open to a soft pale sky. Rounded wind-worn stone arches and ledges occupy only the outer sides; a few broad soft cloud ribbons sit high at the outer edges. Keep the central view low-contrast and spacious, with a wide dry pale blue-gray stone floor and no central opening, staircase or pedestal.
COMPOSITION: 9:20 portrait, 1440 x 3200. The board and UI cover most of the central upper area. Keep the central 76% of the width quiet and mostly featureless; put the theme's bold recognizable details at asymmetric extreme sides and corners, with varied shape, height and spacing. Avoid matching rows or repetitive paired clusters. Keep a broad low-contrast floor in the lower half, which matches this board material: pale cool gray-blue wind-worn stone with soft ivory and faint cyan flat patches, sparse very small flat scuff marks; no cloud banks, swirling lines, arrows, feathers or structures on the board. Board and panels must read clearly. No high-contrast rocks, liquid, branches or objects crossing the central clearing. Keep details visible close enough to the sides for a narrow phone composition, but modest in size. Restrained gentle dark-plum outline weights like input 1; clean bold outer contours on side objects. No board, grid lines, purple divider, baked frame, rounded-corner mask, icons, characters, text or labels. Full bleed opaque image. Output only ONE finished background, no collage or comparison.
